title: outputs/risk-ratings.json — written by the risk-assessor (TODOs #4, #5)
description: The risk-assessor's JUDGMENTS only. .claude/skills/risk-assessment/build_register.py resolves every citation, fills every {{$.path}} placeholder from analytics.json, computes every score and band from history.json, and renders risk-register.md and the auditor-comments.md decision template. A risk whose likelihood or impact justification has no resolvable citation is dropped, by design.

source.description: council = history.json scoring_method (when usable); fallback = 1–5 Very low…Very high, stated in the register header.

revision.description: Required on every re-run after the auditor has recorded decisions. Lists every amend and reject applied so far; the number rises by one each revision.

statement.description: Indicator language. No supplier, officer or department named; no figures.

history_id.description: Must point to an audit with an adverse opinion when applied is true.

sample_source.description: The analytics-full file the planner should sample from.

auditor_override.description: Only on a risk the auditor amended.

justification.description: One sentence with at least one citation: [rule:CPR-13] [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].headline_general_procurement.windows] [history:AUD-05]. Any figure is a {{$.path}} placeholder, never typed.
